requirements.required_cases: Defaults, explicit modes, two independent algorithms, next-solve mode changes, deprecated boolean settings and third-party solver adapters.
requirements.required_assertions: Correct requested/actual mode; per-instance isolation; documented compatibility; useful rejection/fallback reasons.
requirements.remaining: Final suite and third-party contributor lifecycle closure remain open.
requirements.oracle: Requested/actual mode, diagnostics and invocation counters asserted by the API tests.

requirements.required_cases: Full/reduced polar and rectangular matrices; PQ/PV/reference/inactive buses; non-unit voltage and nonzero angle.
requirements.required_assertions: Independent physical P/Q balance, correct row ordering/masks, derivative agreement and correct linear correction.
requirements.remaining: Independent derivatives pass; the complete per-configuration linear-correction/accepted-output traceability still needs closure.
requirements.oracle: Frozen pre-consolidation assembler plus independent physical-current finite differences.

requirements.required_cases: Constant P/I/Z, ZIP, exponential, function and contributed loads, distributed generation, low-voltage adjustment and threshold boundaries.
requirements.required_assertions: Correct values and derivatives; refresh after parameter/service changes; explicit capability handling; existing model precedence retained.
requirements.remaining: Expand mode-specific provider, distributed generation and low-voltage threshold combinations.
requirements.oracle: Frozen assembly, analytical voltage-load checks and independent physical-current differences for covered providers.

requirements.required_cases: Lines, ground/parallel branches, transformers, asymmetric taps, phase shifts, impedance multipliers, terminal charging/shunts and supported impedance tables.
requirements.required_assertions: Both endpoint self-admittances and mutual terms update correctly; ground/ZBR handling and custom contracts remain valid.
requirements.remaining: Close specialized impedance-table/custom-branch capability and all interaction sequences.
requirements.oracle: Frozen assembly and both-endpoint transformer mutation/derivative checks.

requirements.required_cases: Positive/negative/zero B; switched shunt and SVC together; fixed banks; devices at PQ/PV/reference buses; service/lock changes, addition/removal/reconnection and large B.
requirements.required_assertions: Exactly one physical contribution; base isolation; current live Q and derivatives; correct generation results; physical Yii/Y APIs retained.
requirements.remaining: Close all device service/reconnection and large-B histories across modes.
requirements.oracle: Physical Y/power inspection, live-B equations and independent finite differences.

requirements.required_cases: Bus/branch addition/removal, activity, endpoints, ordering, numbering, PV/PQ/reference changes and contributor layout changes.
requirements.required_assertions: Correct plan/mask rebuild and factor invalidation; no stale destinations; numerical zero slots retained.
requirements.remaining: Contributor-layout and complete structural interaction coverage remain open.
requirements.oracle: Fresh reference assembly, explicit stale receipt rejection and structural action checks.

requirements.required_cases: Every coefficient mutation, notification-suppressed writes, external injection changes and mutations after reuse-policy selection.
requirements.required_assertions: Fresh residual/model data and the required refactor/rebuild before solving; ordinary voltage updates preserve the configured NR reuse policy.
requirements.remaining: Complete post-policy callback and LU action interaction mapping remains open.
requirements.oracle: Fresh assembly/public residuals after mutations and recorded matrix actions.

requirements.required_cases: Different trial voltages, restored voltages, changed injections, changed model/control state and repeated accepted states.
requirements.required_assertions: Residuals, Jacobians and accepted powers carry valid state stamps; stale RHS and allocation reuse are rejected.
requirements.remaining: Close rejected control/trial receipt interactions with specialized contributors.
requirements.oracle: Current public model residuals and explicit old receipt/allocation rejection.

requirements.required_cases: Direct CSC versus matrix publication, inspection, RHS APIs, structural zeros, changed dimensions, symbol transfers and deliberately colliding pattern hashes.
requirements.required_assertions: Equivalent matrix/solution; exact structural compatibility; correct numerical invalidation; supported public mutations remain visible.
requirements.remaining: Include exact-pattern collision, symbol transfer and failure receipts from the final full audit.
requirements.oracle: Frozen matrix entries, independent derivative checks and public block/scalar inspection parity.

requirements.required_cases: Polar relative magnitude, rectangular absolute corrections, global/per-variable limits, inactive/reference updates, PV target restoration and negative polar magnitude.
requirements.required_assertions: Existing correction conventions and bounds; correct maxima; equivalent represented phasor after canonicalization.
requirements.remaining: Map the completed correction checks to every supported execution strategy at release.
requirements.oracle: Independently computed corrections/maxima and exact published field snapshots.

requirements.required_cases: Existing supported optimizers, zero/partial/full scale, accepted/rejected trials, numerical failure and control rollback.
requirements.required_assertions: Continuous trials, current residual evaluation, restoration of workspace/published state and no reuse of rejected trial results.
requirements.remaining: Close control rollback and rejected-candidate allocation histories with contributor contracts.
requirements.oracle: Exact pre-trial state snapshots, exception restoration and existing optimizer fixtures.

requirements.required_cases: PV-to-PQ-to-PV, generator Q limits, local/remote voltage/Q control, continuous/discrete shunts and SVCs, tap/phase/area controls.
requirements.required_assertions: Correct active sets, row/column changes, limits, control residuals and electrical convergence in all supported modes.
requirements.remaining: Contributor contract migration and transition-history mapping remain open.
requirements.oracle: Existing electrical/control residual, limit and active-set fixtures; further history closure remains pending.

requirements.required_cases: Actual augmented zero-impedance branches, retained terminal shunts, auxiliary flows, multiple auxiliaries and topology changes.
requirements.required_assertions: Electrical and auxiliary residuals both converge; auxiliary rows/RHS are refreshed; no duplicate series/shunt contribution.
requirements.remaining: The shared contributor and combined control/ZBR response contracts now pass. Complete specialized coefficient/capability admission and all release interaction sequences remain required.
requirements.oracle: Existing augmented electrical/auxiliary residual and zero-impedance fixtures.

requirements.required_cases: Existing supported LCC/VSC/HVDC coupling, external-power refresh, rollback and network-response Jacobians.
requirements.required_assertions: Correct refresh ordering and derivatives; mandatory electrical auxiliaries retained; existing control exclusions honored.
requirements.remaining: Close composed response-view contracts and coupling rollback mapping.
requirements.oracle: Existing coupled-converter and response-view electrical/control assertions.

requirements.required_cases: Custom Yii/power/load providers, legacy solver overrides, callbacks, EMF observers, logging and getters during trials and accepted iterations.
requirements.required_assertions: Correct callback/publication order, preserved overrides, no recursion/double stamping, and explicit limits on reusable preparation.
requirements.remaining: Close all custom provider/observer admission boundaries after contributor migration.
requirements.oracle: Known custom callback outputs, invocation counts and observer-visible state.

requirements.required_cases: Reference/PV/PQ generation, fixed P/Q, multiple generators, inactive generators, distributed generation and compensation with non-unit voltage.
requirements.required_assertions: Existing allocation/limit rules, totals and public results; allocation uses the accepted state rather than a trial or stale power vector.
requirements.remaining: Add explicit distributed-generation and rejected-trial allocation interaction coverage.
requirements.oracle: Established model allocation outputs, fixed/inactive records and accepted-state parity.

requirements.required_cases: Forced rebuild, numerical refactor and permitted LU reuse, each under generic and cached preparation with identical policy settings.
requirements.required_assertions: Correct action and counter values; invalid model changes override stale reuse; mode choice does not silently alter numerical policy.
requirements.remaining: Close forced action and mutation-after-policy traces for the final implementation.
requirements.oracle: Recorded preparation/assembly/solve work and existing reuse-policy assertions.

requirements.required_cases: Cold solve, retained preparation, previous-solution initialization, network/backend/coordinate replacement, mode switches and exceptions during solve cleanup.
requirements.required_assertions: Correct lifecycle reset; no cross-network or cross-algorithm state leakage; scope cleanup and documented final state.
requirements.remaining: Complete the remaining backend/coordinate/network replacement and failed-factorization repair interaction sequences; common scope cleanup and recovery now have positive bridge coverage.
requirements.oracle: Instance ownership, report/build counts and fresh solve comparisons.

requirements.required_cases: Direct NR steps, matrix create/update calls, PQ-to-NR handoff, full-Newton control responses and ordinary PQ/GS/FDNR consumers.
requirements.required_assertions: Shared-kernel coverage and public helper compatibility; unchanged behavior of other methods and declared unsupported combinations.
requirements.remaining: Per-matrix contributor response ownership now passes, including mandatory ZBR equations. Final full helper/handoff audit remains open.
requirements.oracle: Existing public helper/handoff/control fixtures and frozen electrical assembly.

requirements.required_cases: Imported standard networks, supported static/dynamic load-flow containers, custom/three-phase compatibility and child-network behavior.
requirements.required_assertions: Correct model/provider selection and outputs; specialized solvers keep their supported contracts; required fixtures are present.
requirements.remaining: Full imported/three-phase/child-network regression audit remains open.
requirements.oracle: Imported-network/public load-flow fixtures and physical dynamic-Y transfer assertions.

requirements.required_cases: Load flow before initialization, invalidation at initialization, coupled small-case faults, shunt switching, clearing and representative large-case runs.
requirements.required_assertions: Physical Norton Y retained; unchanged integration/tolerance settings; complete required timestamps, event sides, channels and state comparisons.
requirements.remaining: Coupled fault, physical shunt-switch and large-case trajectory qualification remain open.
requirements.oracle: Existing static-to-dynamic transfer fixtures; complete coupled trace closure remains pending.

requirements.required_cases: Singular/failed factorization, failed preparation, non-convergence, non-finite model results, invalid voltage/configuration and missing required fixtures.
requirements.required_assertions: Existing failure contracts and diagnostics; no use of an obsolete factor/evaluation; safe cleanup and valid recovery or explicit termination.
requirements.remaining: Complete singular/failure/repair and missing-fixture recovery sequences.
requirements.oracle: Explicit expected failure reasons/stages and existing recovery fixtures.

requirements.required_cases: Every mode/coordinate kernel, contributors, cache hits, fallbacks and legacy API shims.
requirements.required_assertions: One production formulation per coordinate; all new selection/invalidation decisions exercised; old mathematical implementation confined to test references.
requirements.remaining: Historical standalone numerical API, separate specialized coefficient/capability contracts and final source/execution coverage closure remain. Ordered contributors, exact structural layouts, per-matrix response roles and trial ownership are implemented and verified.
requirements.oracle: Mode/build/assembly counters, common plan/kernel tests and source review; standalone migration remains pending.

requirements.required_cases: Unified cached/generic comparison, frozen maintained baseline and separate external-reference comparisons.
requirements.required_assertions: Matched workload and settings; actual mode/reuse coverage, retained samples, compilation time and runtime/source fingerprints.
requirements.remaining: All-five-case warmed cached/RustPower recheck completed with retained samples, mode and accuracy receipts. Final generic/frozen comparisons and release qualification after remaining migrations are still required.
requirements.oracle: Qualified nodal operators, independent residual/reference voltage checks, raw wall times and execution receipts.
